patch_description: The previous SEARCH failed due to a mismatched comment line ("t = 0" vs "t=0") and incorrect indentation on the first lines. Re-proposing the same edit with the SEARCH text matching the file verbatim: vectorize the weighted linear regression using np.convolve (running weighted sums), apply the robust Huber reweighting pass only to outlier-contaminated windows, and add a slope-consistency snap step that replaces sub-noise output fluctuations with a blend toward a 3-tap running median. This reduces slope churn and false reversals while keeping tracking accuracy, and the vectorization recovers the lost efficiency headroom.
